title: TariTalk Nodes
summary: Independent community map of voluntarily registered, manually reviewed Minotari mainnet full nodes, with approximate locations, sync status and a deployment guide. Includes separately labeled anonymous Tari Netmap locations; it is not a complete network map. The site credits TariTalk; the forum announcement credits Zhao Xi with the website. November 2 review covered the map, regional filtering, deployment guide and privacy notes. The deployment-tool repository linked by the guide returned 404, so installation was not verified. No node was registered, software installed or query endpoint exposed. Base nodes are not miners or seed nodes; no rewards are implied.
cardSummary: Explore a community map of Tari full nodes and a guide to running your own.
